entries.26b9c673e3d1bb10: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue by product and service was: automotive-related products ¥20,646 million, heat treatment contract processing-related ¥12,943 million, civil engineering and construction-related products ¥12,562 million, induction heating equipment-related ¥6,566 million, construction machinery-related products ¥3,701 million, and other ¥1,856 million. Revenue by region was: Japan ¥35,415 million, China ¥11,295 million, the United States ¥6,589 million, Europe ¥3,735 million, other Asia ¥1,095 million, and other ¥147 million. It is stated that no specific external customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue.

entries.6752361d6426cbe6: Built on high-frequency surface hardening and other induction heating technology, the group handles everything from manufacturing steel products and heat treatment contract processing to manufacturing and selling induction heating equipment. Heat treatment contract processing is carried out not only at domestic plants but also at subsidiaries in China, Indonesia and Mexico, and induction heating equipment is also manufactured and sold by subsidiaries in China and South Korea, giving the company an overseas base network.
entries.6a20fe7655caf66c: Under the 16th Medium-Term Management Plan, 'Aggressive Challenge One NETUREN 2026' (a three-year plan from April 2024 to March 2027), the company is pursuing four basic strategies: 'Creating growth drivers,' 'Developing growth engines,' 'Expanding global markets,' and 'Nurturing human resources with a voluntary willingness to contribute.' The slogan of the long-term management vision 'NETUREN VISION 2030' is 'Evolution and Leap Forward.'
